resources.string: Shows the album art of the music playing on the lock screen, like Android 10 and custom ROMs, plus synced Spotify lyrics. Built for the Android 17 Scene Container.
Checking that the module is loaded
Enable the module in LSPosed with the “System UI” scope and restart System UI.
System UI responded but couldn’t find the lock screen. Restart it.
Over the wallpaper, below the clock and notifications
Don’t remove it when the music is paused
While playing: no player or notifications on the lock screen, and the song under the clock. The player is still there when you pull down the shade
When you turn off the screen while something with lyrics plays, it stays in ambient mode showing the lyrics. Without music it follows your settings. Uses more battery
A subtle moon above the lyrics to turn ambient display lyrics on or off instantly
Synced word by word on the lock screen
The preview uses the same drawing as the lock screen
White when your lock screen wallpaper uses dark text
Needed after enabling or updating the module
LSPosed will ask permission to load the module in Spotify; then close and reopen Spotify
Done: close and reopen Spotify to load the lyrics

Spotify lyrics adapted from the spotify-music provider of LyricProvider (tomakino, Apache-2.0), with ideas from SuperLyric (HChenX). Class lookup with DexKit (LuckyPray, LGPL-3.0 / Apache-2.0). The lyrics come from Spotify and are used with your own session, only on your phone.
This app has no root: grant it in KernelSU or restart the phone.
